import json
SPEC = json.loads('{"sentences": {"opening": "Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We are recording this call. Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?", "confirm_q": "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?", "robot": "I am Freya Bank\'s digital assistant.", "scam": "You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank\'s customer service number.", "pre_id_about": "I can tell you more once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person.", "third_q": "When can {title} {last_name} be reached?", "deceased": "I am sorry for your loss.", "dob_q": "For your security, could you please tell me your date of birth?", "phone_q": "Thank you. Now, could you tell me the last four digits of the phone number we have on file?", "protect": "These questions protect your account.", "swapped": "Could you please say the month of your date of birth as a word?", "wrong": "That does not match our records.", "failed": "I am sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.", "tech": "There was a technical problem. I will try once more.", "today_q1": "Can you make this payment today?", "today_qn": "Can you make these payments today?", "paid": "Thank you. Goodbye."}}')

def _f(s):
    return s.replace('{title}', str(vars.get('title') or '')).replace('{last_name}', str(vars.get('last_name') or ''))
vars['say'] = _f(SPEC['sentences']['opening'])
vars['q'] = _f(SPEC['sentences']['confirm_q'])
vars['last_say'] = vars['say']
vars['st'] = 'confirm'
vars['act'] = 'talk'
vars['outcome'] = ''
vars['reason'] = ''
vars['pending'] = ''
vars['P_json'] = '[]'
for k in ['intent', 'dob_day', 'dob_month', 'dob_year', 'digits', 'when_words', 'time_words', 'amount', 'product_ref']:

talk.name: talk
talk.task_message: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on a phone call, speaking English. Say exactly this text: "{{say}}". Never promise a transfer, a callback or any other action that the text does not state. Do not add anything else.

extraction_schema.name: intent
extraction_schema.description: What the customer's LAST message does, one value. yes: confirms (yes, that's me, speaking, own name, accepts the offer or read-back). no: a plain no (to 'am I speaking with', the offer, or paying today). not_me: someone else answered (a relative, 'she is not here', 'I am her husband'). wrong_number: the number does not belong to the customer. deceased: the customer has died. robot: asks if you are a robot or AI. scam: asks if this is a scam or fraud. what_about: asks what the call is about or who is calling. question: any other question. human: asks for a human, a person, an agent. refuse_talk: says they do not want to talk. refuse_id: will not answer the security question. refuse: refuses to pay with no date and no amount. cant_today: cannot pay today (if they also name a day, still fill when_words). too_much: the full amount is too much. paid: says they already paid this amount. dispute: says the debt or product is not theirs, never had it, or it was closed or paid off in the past, or a charge is wrong. hardship: illness, a death in the family, or job loss. plan: explicitly asks for a new payment plan, instalments, restructuring or lower instalments (naming a date they can pay is NOT a plan). discount: asks for a discount, waiver or lower amount. change_promise: wants to change or cancel an already recorded promise. other: anything else. unclear: cut off, hello, go ahead, or cannot tell. none: nothing said.

extraction_schema.name: dob_day
extraction_schema.description: Day of the month of the customer's date of birth, as digits (1-31), from the last message only. 'none' if not said.

extraction_schema.name: dob_month
extraction_schema.description: Month of the customer's date of birth as a number 1-12 ('June' -> 6), from the last message only. When only numbers are said, read them as day, then month, then year. 'none' if not said.

extraction_schema.name: dob_year
extraction_schema.description: Year of birth as four digits ('nineteen eighty seven' -> 1987, 'two thousand and five' -> 2005), last message only. 'none' if not said.

extraction_schema.name: digits
extraction_schema.description: Phone digits the customer said in the last message, as digits only ('four eight two one' -> 4821). 'none' if not said.

extraction_schema.name: when_words
extraction_schema.description: The customer's own words for a day they offer (to pay, or for a callback), copied as said: 'tomorrow', 'next Friday', 'the 20th', 'October 20', 'today', 'next week'. Only from the last message. A day they say they already paid on is not filled. 'none' if no day.

extraction_schema.name: time_words
extraction_schema.description: The customer's own words for a time of day, copied as said ('eleven in the morning', '3 pm', '15:30'). Last message only. 'none' if no time.

extraction_schema.name: amount
extraction_schema.description: An amount of money the customer offers to pay, as a number with a dot for decimals ('two hundred fifty' -> 250). Last message only. 'none' if no amount.

extraction_schema.name: product_ref
extraction_schema.description: Which product the customer's last message is about: credit_card, personal_loan, car_loan, all (all/both/everything), or none.

system_prompt: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on a phone call. Speak English. Say only the text you are given.
